review_method: Human editorial review of all 496 public video titles/descriptions, keyword/context screening across every description, and targeted external fact checks. Not a viewing or full-transcript audit.
scope: Featured interviewees and panelists; personal Apple employment, contract work, NeXT, Steve Jobs-era Pixar, Apple-platform vendors, suppliers, financing/marketing/legal support. All installments retained for a qualifying person. Interviewers/moderators alone do not qualify a video.
selection_policy: Recall prioritized over precision. include = identified concrete connection; maybe = plausible or deliberately peripheral hypothesis needing confirmation; storage_supplier_reserve is a separate low-confidence industry reserve. not_selected = no specific tie identified, not a definitive negative.
caveats: Titles are preserved as returned by the playlist, including spelling errors and renamed episodes.
Individual video IDs, rather than row numbers or titles, are canonical keys.
Apple-related people can discuss unrelated career periods; inclusion does not mean an episode is primarily about Apple.
Not all company-level product links establish an individual’s personal work on that product.
The existing RSS is a 433-episode January 2025 snapshot; absence of an audio link does not mean that no audio can be obtained.
External source URLs support particular connection claims, not a claim to have read every linked transcript in full.

The separate chm-apple-audio.json maps the 61 Apple/NeXT employee episodes to verified public audio URLs. Interview recording dates determine feed chronology; YouTube publication timestamps are retained separately.
